Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorThermalModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorThermalModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CompressorThermalModel extends Object implements Serializable
Lumped-parameter thermal network for a compressor.

Each non-boundary node obeys C dT/dt = Q + sum(G * (Tneighbour - T)). The steady-state and implicit-Euler transient solvers use the same network. Conductances and heat capacities are deliberately explicit calibration parameters: local metal temperatures depend on machine geometry, material, oil flow, seal flow and operating history and cannot be inferred from the process-gas outlet temperature alone.

API 617 and API 692 define the relevant compressor, bearing and dry-gas-seal system scope. They do not provide a universal rotor thermal network. Template values supplied by CompressorCatalog are therefore screening values and should be replaced with OEM data or fitted plant measurements before integrity decisions are made.
